datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Djibouti on a monthly basis throughout 2012. Geographic boundaries were classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. Data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with metadata on classification scale, collection date, scenario, and assistance requirements.
